---
title: "Reflection Symmetric System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& x+xy\\
\dot{y} &=& -z\\
\dot{z} &=& y+az+x^2
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.2$ and initial condition $(1,-13,32)$.
